subject.title: feat: unify external sessions with native catalog pagination

question: Should an existing explicit `supervision.enabled: false` continue to opt out of the operator Codex catalog after upgrade, or should it now disable only agent-facing tools?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes a stored consent and transcript-exposure contract; implementation review cannot choose that compatibility policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve existing opt-out
options.body: Keep `false` authoritative for catalog visibility and introduce a separately consented catalog-only path if desired.

options.title: Migrate to tools-only meaning
options.body: Expose catalogs for plugin-active upgrades only with an explicit doctor migration, release communication, and fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

options.title: Split automatic activation
options.body: Land the generic API and native UI separately while deferring zero-config catalog activation and adoption.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing opt-out
recommendation.body: Keep `false` authoritative for catalog visibility and introduce a separately consented catalog-only path if desired.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current consent behavior and owns the recent Codex, Claude, and native-session product direction.
